mapper.select: SELECT hlma.document_name, hlma.description, hlma.mortgage_attachment_id, hlma.mortgage_id, (select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_MORTGAGE_ATTACH' and hlma.mortgage_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id, (select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_MORTGAGE_ATTACH' and hlma.mortgage_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name, (select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_MORTGAGE_ATTACH' and hlma.mortgage_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date, (select max(su.description) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam, sys_user su where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_MORTGAGE_ATTACH' and hlma.mortgage_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value and su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person FROM hls_lease_mortgage_attach hlma where hlma.mortgage_id = #{mortgageId1}
